album: Jazzkaar festival escapes jazz but still compels
excerpt: The 36th edition of the Jazzkaar Festival once again confirmed why it remains one of northern Europe's most compelling jazz gatherings. Held over the course of a week in the Estonian capital, the festival – founded by the indefatigable Anne Erm – continues to attract audiences across generations thanks to a programme that stretches well beyond traditional jazz boundaries.
